verdict.rationale: smolagents is itself an official, first-party Python SDK/library from Hugging Face for building agents, with extensive official documentation (guided tour, tool tutorials, reference API), pip-installable package, and GitHub repo confirming its purpose and API surface (CodeAgent, ToolCallingAgent, Tool subclassing, agent.run/step/replay). Community discussion (HN) corroborates real hands-on use of the SDK. Missing for 10: independent multi-language SDK bindings beyond Python and more third-party ecosystem validation beyond one HN thread.
